agents.meterNote: On the house lane your memes come out of this monthly meter. Connect your own key (BYOK) and the meter lifts — you pay a cent per call on your key, the bot never stops.
agents.seatsFull: All your bot seats are rented — upgrade for more.

doors.alreadyBody: One play a day — new memes, new callers, a new shuffle tomorrow.
doors.auctionClosedNote: This week's auction has closed. Losing bids were refunded in full.
doors.auctionLosersNote: Losing bids are refunded in full at close. The winner's points burn.
doors.auctionNoBids: No bids yet — the opening bid is {min} points.
doors.backTomorrow: New memes, new shuffle tomorrow. One play a day.
doors.bankerBeatYou: The Banker got the better of it by {amount}.
doors.callItTitle: Call it first — optional, but streaks pay

college-kid.name: College Kid
college-kid.pitch1: Yo, College Kid. My Banker? Total chaos — offers come out of a random roll and a dream.
college-kid.pitch2: Could be amazing. Could be embarrassing. That's college.
college-kid.pitch3: Hit the jackpot door and I'll throw in 50 extra credits from my textbook fund.
college-kid.teaser: Dorm-room hustle. My Banker is chaos.

grandma.name: Grandma
grandma.pitch1: Sweetie, it's Grandma. I baked five doors today.
grandma.pitch2: One of them has 805 credits with your name written on it in frosting.
grandma.pitch3: The Banker will call. Be polite. Then say no.
grandma.teaser: Come sit, sweetie. Grandma's Banker is generous.

grandpa.name: Grandpa
grandpa.perk: Stingy Banker · a correct Read pays double
grandpa.pitch1: It's Grandpa. The Banker today is a cheapskate — I taught him everything he knows.
grandpa.pitch2: Read him right at the end and the house pays you double for it.
grandpa.pitch3: Pick your door like you mean it.
grandpa.teaser: Doors, eh? In my day we earned our credits.

joe.name: Jobless Joe
joe.perk: Balanced · the Banker plays it straight
joe.pitch1: Kid, it's Joe. Behind those doors? Credits. Real ones.
joe.pitch2: Pick a door to keep, open the rest, and don't let the Banker cheap you out.
joe.pitch3: There are no jobs. So we play doors now.
joe.teaser: I got a deal with your name on it, kid.

shop-owner-mike.name: Shop Owner Mike
shop-owner-mike.perk: Supplier tip · one door is not the jackpot
shop-owner-mike.pitch1: Mike here. I stock shelves for a living — I know when a box is empty.
shop-owner-mike.pitch2: One of those doors is NOT hiding the jackpot. I'll point at it before we start.
shop-owner-mike.pitch3: The rest is your gut. Spend it wisely.
shop-owner-mike.teaser: I know the suppliers. One door is lying to you.

young-mom.name: Young Mom
young-mom.pitch1: Hi! Young Mom here. Between school runs I learned to read a room — and a door.
young-mom.pitch2: I'll share one door's secret before we start. Call it mom intuition.
young-mom.pitch3: Now let's win you some generations.
young-mom.teaser: I run a business from my kitchen table. I also read doors.

doors.pickerSubtitle: Your caller sets the Banker, the perks, and the mood. Choose wisely.
doors.pickerTitle: Three phones are ringing. Who do you answer?
doors.readHint: Lock a guess of your door's band before the final decision. Right = +50 bonus credits (double with Grandpa). Wrong = nothing lost.
doors.referralBody: Bid Points come only from referrals — they can't be bought, and game credits can't convert into them. When a member joins with your link: +10 points when they finish a doors game, +25 when they play on 3 different days, +10 when they claim a prize.
doors.soldLine: You sold your door for {amount}. It held {held}.
doors.subtitle: A daily festival of doors, memes and one very cheap Banker. Pick a caller, keep a door, beat the Banker — winnings land as free generations.
doors.sweatApplied: Banker Sweat applied: +10% on this offer.
doors.sweatToast: Banker Sweat armed — your next offer gets +10%.
doors.title: Who's Calling? Doors

nav.taglineBody: Every piece is culturally adapted by a native-voice engine — never word-for-word translation.

onboarding.bridgeNote: No key yet? Start free on the bridge — packs and previews, on us.
onboarding.byokBody: Connect your own P&R key and the house meter lifts. You pay a cent per call on your own key, your bots run uncapped, and the rental is just for the bots and the platform. Guided key setup arrives with the BYOK onboarding pass — until then, the house lane above is the way in.
onboarding.byokTitle: The upgrade: bring your own key
onboarding.step1Body: One tap, no key pasting. Your key stays on P&R — we get a scoped pass to run on your credits.
onboarding.step2Body: Spin up the agent workforce that runs the engine for you.
onboarding.step3Body: Your Muse, your tokens — a lifetime supply through the invite.

plans.byokUpgrade: BYOK upgrade: your key, your fuel, caps lift

plans.entitlementsNote: Plan entitlements are configurable — actual subscriptions and billing are managed by Whop. Do not treat this as payment.

referral.body: Earn 30% when a member you invite sets up their first agent.
referral.bodyFull: Every member who joins with your link and sets up their first agent earns you 30% of their plan — plus XP: +50 when they join, +150 when they convert.
referral.freeGensNote: Plus {count} free generations land in your account when a member you invited saves their links on the bridge — they spend automatically when your plan's monthly generations run out, so your agents keep creating past the cap.
referral.unlockNote: Commissions unlock at {need} confirmed sign-ups ({have}/{need}). Commissions begin with the sign-up that unlocks you — and a connected P&R key will also be required once Connect lands.
referral.empty: No recruits yet — your link is your loudest weapon. Share it where business owners hang out.
referral.simulated: Earnings SIMULATED until payouts go live
referral.title: Refer & Earn
